Name: Shared Fridge With Spouse
Author: logNest
Description:
[b]Supported languages:[/b] English（English descriptions are below）, 简体中文

[b][size=5]Shared Fridge With Spouse 和伴侣共享冰箱[/size][/b]

Shared Fridge With Spouse 是一个适用于《星露谷物语》1.6 的轻量级 SMAPI 模组。
你的伴侣或室友会偶尔从厨房冰箱里拿走他们喜欢的可食用物品。食物被拿走后，打开冰箱时会显示当天提示，也可以通过冰箱上方的历史记录按钮（或打开冰箱后按快捷键H）查看最近的消耗记录。（历史记录最多保留50条）
消耗食物会增加好感，相当于一次正常送礼，但不占用送礼次数。
消耗食物当天会有相关对话。

食物的定义：可获得能量值、生命值大于0的物品。

[b]配置项[/b]
[list]
[*]每日消耗概率：伴侣/室友每天拿走食物的概率，默认 50。[/*]
[*]每种物品保留数量：每种食物至少保留多少个，默认 1。[/*]
[*]允许消耗喜欢食物：开启后，除了最爱食物，也会拿喜欢食物。[/*]
[*]保护高价食物：开启后，售价达到“ 高价食物最低金额 ”的食物不会被拿走。[/*]
[*]高价食物最低金额：默认 1000g。[/*]
[*]显示冰箱提示：下次打开冰箱时提示谁拿走了什么。[/*]
[*]打开历史记录快捷键：默认 H。[/*]
[*]Debug 日志：输出调试信息。[/*]
[/list]配置可通过 config.json 修改，也支持 Generic Mod Config Menu。

[b]兼容性[/b]
[list]
[*]支持多婚/多伴侣，会识别所有已婚或室友 NPC （已测试 PolyamorySweet）。[/*]
[*]支持自定义 NPC，只要该 NPC  能像其他村民一样结婚或成为室友，并且有自己的礼物喜好数据。 [/*]
[*]当前只支持主屋厨房冰箱。[/*]
[/list]
mod更新永久免费。如果喜欢这个mod，觉得本mod有帮助，欢迎[url=https://lognest111.github.io/wechat.png]赞赏作者[/url]。
 
[b][size=4]English[/size][/b]
Shared Fridge With Spouse is a lightweight SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley 1.6.
Your spouse or roommate will occasionally take edible items they like from the kitchen fridge. After food is taken, a notification will appear the next time you open the fridge. You can also check recent consumption records using the history button above the fridge, or by pressing the H key while the fridge is open. (The history keeps a maximum of 50 entries)
Eating food increases friendship, just like a normal gift, but does not count toward the daily or weekly gift limit.
On the day food is taken, there will also be related dialogue.

Food definition: items that restore energy and have HP greater than 0.

[b]Config Options[/b]
[list]
[*]Daily consumption chance: Chance for each spouse/roommate to take food each day. Default: 50.[/*]
[*]Reserved stock per item: Minimum amount to keep for each food item. Default: 1.[/*]
[*]Allow liked foods: Also allows liked foods, not just loved foods.[/*]
[*]Protect valuable foods: Prevents food with a sell price at or above the “valuable food minimum price” from being taken.[/*]
[*]Valuable food minimum price: Default: 1000g.[/*]
[*]Show fridge notifications: Shows who took what the next time you open the fridge.[/*]
[*]Open fridge history key: Default: H.[/*]
[*]Debug logging: Outputs debug information.[/*]
[/list]Config can be edited through config.json, and Generic Mod Config Menu is also supported.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Supports multi-spouse / multi-partner setups by detecting all married or roommate NPCs. Tested with PolyamorySweet.[/*]
[*]Supports custom NPCs, as long as the NPC can marry or become a roommate like other villagers and has their own gift taste data.[/*]
[*]Currently only supports the main farmhouse kitchen fridge.[/*]
[/list]
